title: ITTF World Masters Championships 2024
excerpt: ATTP members take part in the ITTF World Masters Championships 2024
body_html:
One of every person’s greatest assets is their health, and the best way to promote a healthy lifestyle is, of course, to play sport.

☝️ The National Sports Association ATTP is the main organisational centre coordinating the development and support of veterans’ table tennis nationwide. ATTP’s activities cover a wide range of projects, including organising competitions, rehabilitation and charity events, training programmes and promoting a healthy lifestyle. The Association also works actively to strengthen ties with international sports organisations for development and cooperation.

💪 This year the ATTP team (Oleg Dobrjinschi – President of Top Cup Academy, Alexandru Policiuc – founder of TOP CUP, Vadim Burucenco) is representing the Republic of Moldova🇲🇩 at the ITTF World Masters Championships 2024 — an event for the champions of the present and the past!

❗️ As a reminder, the Championships, held in Rome 🇮🇹 with more than 6,000 players from about 110 member associations around the world, have already gone down in world table tennis history as the grandest sporting event of all time.

👍 Our players Oleg Dobrjinschi and Alexandru Policiuc successfully came through the first stages of the championships, winning convincingly against players from France, Germany and India and advancing to the final phase.

🤝 I would like to thank the lads for the great joy and pride that all ATTP members and most of the country’s table tennis fans are feeling right now.

After qualifying from the subgroup, our team placed among the 32 best teams in the world⚡️. This performance, together with our master Ursu Vladislav qualifying for the Paris 2024 Olympic Games, shows that Moldovan table tennis is not standing still. Taking part in prestigious world competitions like these, and every win in them, means that today we have moved up a class compared with where we were before.
